records.title: Critical pairs for the Product Singleton Bound
records.evidence_read: Theorem3.3 and its proof, Lemmas2.7/2.9/2.10 and the finite-field descent; no MDS hypothesis is needed for this use.
records.mechanism: Small coordinatewise code-product dimension forces a large stabilizer algebra and disjoint code components.
records.problem_family: Products of vector spaces in the coordinatewise algebra K^m, including binary linear codes.
records.reduction: Apply to R*span(1,W)=R+R*W after puncturing zero parity columns; derive native binary signature-space envelope counts locally.
records.no_go_barrier: Low-dimensional native pencil images cannot be promoted from rare structured codes; larger correlated matrix spaces and different quantum architectures remain open.
records.proof_technique: Coordinatewise Kneser inequality, projector decomposition, and base-field extension with stabilizer descent.
records.open_question: Can a compact large-rank pivot architecture implement higher-carry normalization, or can quantum branch mixing avoid a classical transport problem?
records.reusable_abstraction: Track product dimension, zero support, unit membership, stabilizer components, source probability and adaptive selection menus separately.
